en: Black‑and‑white view across a river with moored steamships in the foreground. On the near ship the letters "DDSG" and "E.P. 30" are visible on the bow. Behind the ships, on a wooded hill, stands a very large, ornate palace-like complex with multiple domes and mansard roofs; a dense cityscape stretches along the riverbank and up the hills, with a distinct church tower and spires in the distance. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century cityscape postcard.
